description: Every post on the user's ledger with its views read from the post's public page (at most every 15 minutes), the money it has earned so far against its campaign's own rate and cap, how many views it needs before the campaign pays anything, whether it is below that minimum, whether it has stalled (under 2% more views in the last day), a one-line verdict, and its submit window state. Views that could not be read come back null, never 0.

limit.description: How many of the newest posts (default 20, max 50)
